draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.47, the 10th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 2nd of 23 at DE. He went 11th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Gregory Rousseau. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 5 sacks in 2024, 17th of 23 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the San Francisco 49ers (physically unable to perform). 9 career games and 9 starts over 1 completed season. Still developing: 4 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 0.0% (95th percentile). Weak spots: pressures 4 (19th percentile), sacks 1.0 (22nd percentile). Played 9 of 17 games in 2025.
